title: YouTube, Netflix, Fox are in play for special five-game 2026 package

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: YouTube, Netflix, Fox are in play for special five-game 2026 package
sources.description: As the NFL embarks on an effort to renegotiate its various full-season TV packages, the league continues to shop a five-game package of games to be televised during the 2026 season.
